Thank you for being part of Ctrl Wallet.

As of August 19, 2026, Ctrl Wallet has been permanently shut down. It has been a privilege to serve you.

Your assets are still yours. As long as you have your recovery phrase, you can import it into any compatible wallet and continue managing your funds.

⚠️ Never share your recovery phrase with anyone. Ctrl Wallet will never ask for it and neither will any legitimate service.

FAQ
How do I take part in the Midnight Scavenger Mine?

You can read our full guide on how to take part in the Midnight Scavenger Mine here.

How do I claim the Midnight Glacier Airdrop $NIGHT token?

You can check out our full guide on how to claim your Midnight Glacier Airdrop $NIGHT.

Do you have a mobile wallet application?

Yes, our mobile applications are now available on the App Store / Play Store. IOS: https://apps.apple.com/ng/app/ctrl-wallet/id6630386336 Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=xyz.ctrl.wallet

Can I migrate my MetaMask, Phantom or Keplr wallet to Ctrl?

Yes, you can migrate any wallet to Ctrl using your wallet’s seed phrase. This process only takes a few seconds, and all of your assets and NFTs will immediately appear in Ctrl.

Please see our quick start guide here.

How do I connect to a dapp if I don't see the Ctrl logo?

Ctrl can connect to all dapps on all supported chains. In many cases you will see the Ctrl logo when you go to ‘connect wallet’. If you do not see the Ctrl logo, you can still connect to the dapp by clicking on the first wallet in the list, usually MetaMask, Keplr or Phantom. Please make sure you have ‘prioritize Ctrl’ turned on in your Ctrl settings.

What is a non-custodial wallet?

Unlike centralized exchanges, non-custodial wallets offer you full control over your seed phrase, private keys and assets (including NFTs). Forgetting or losing your seed phrase and private keys means losing access to your deposit addresses and the funds you hold on them, so make sure to back them up.

We recommend offline storage on at least two devices, one of which has FLASH memory. Encrypting the digital device holding this information is a good practice as long as you remember your decryption password.

XDEFI migrated to Ctrl. What does this mean for me as an XDEFI user?

Your existing XDEFI Wallet browser extension will automatically update and be migrated to the new Ctrl Wallet. You do not need to do anything during this update.

How do I migrate my $XDEFI to $CTRL?

You can migrate $XDEFI and v$XDEFI to $CTRL here.

Ctrl will pay your gas on the migration until December 31, 2024.

You have until September 2025 to complete the migration.

Are my funds safe?

Yes. Ctrl has been independently audited and your funds always remain completely under your custody. Read more about our security here.

Does Ctrl have control of my coins?

Ctrl is a non-custodial & decentralised wallet.

Remember that your coins or tokens are not stored in your wallet but on the blockchain, your wallet allows you to view and manage them.

Ctrl does NOT have access to your secret phrase, password or recovery code.

You are in complete control of your information and your wallet, so please do keep your secret phrase safe!

I have questions or concerns, where is the best place to ask?

For direct support, you can contact us on our support intercom below or ask in our Discord.
